rows.abstract: Mandates that the basic monthly pension of all government retirees shall be [37 1/2] FIFTY PERCENT (50%) of the revalued average monthly compensation; states that the basic monthly pension SHALL NOT BE LESS THAN P5,000.00 PER MONTH. rows.abstract: Aims to answer these urgent concerns: (1) The need to recognize the vital uses of land; (2) The need to properly assign the types of land and land resources to their most appropriate and beneficial uses; (3) The need to arrest the present threat toagriculture and food security and to protect the forests/natural resources of the country.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09147

rows.abstract: Is premised on the observation that "government has lost moral ground upon which to anchor its imposition of the burdensome expanded VAT ... The imposition of the VAT will negate the reported 5.2% initial growth in the GNP ..."

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE OWNERSHIP AND USE OF CHAINSAW UNITS
rows.abstract: Declares it all UNLAWFUL for any person, whether natural or juridical, to own or possess chainsaw units. Exempts, however, the following for the provision: (1) Duly registered and licensed Timber License Agreement holders; (2) Orchard and fruit treefarmers; (3) Industrial tree farmers; and (4) Others who are in need of chainsaws in their occupation.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04888

rows.abstract: Provides that the MEMBERS OF THE BOARDS REPRESENTING THE WORKERS AND EMPLOYERS SHALL UNDERGO TRAINING SEMINARS FOR THREE (3) MONTHS ON WAGE FIXING AND DETERMINATION TO EQUIP THEM WITH THE NECESSARY SKILLS AND EXPERTISE ON THEIR JOBS. Provides further that the Regional Board shall promulgate the necessary waqe order within 60 days from the time the Board conducts its first public hearing on a petition for wage increase or on its own initiative.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07970
